title: Horsehair Raku Workshop
source_quote:
Raku Workshops
Horsehair Raku
Saturday May 10th at 4:00 p.m.
Saturday July 26th
Saturday August 23rd 4:00pm
evidence_sentence: Horsehair raku workshops decorate pottery by applying horsehair to raku-fired pots removed from a kiln at 1400 degrees.
evidence_quote: It is removed from the kiln around 1400 degrees Fahrenheit and the horsehair is applied to the piece.
summary: Drop-in horsehair raku workshops where you choose a bisque-fired pot and apply horsehair decoration after kiln-firing; outdoors setting.
bring: None specified; pre-made bisque pots provided
